Paired with %1$s. Tracking data is now encrypted, and the PC is found again when its address changes.
Wrong code. VRCFaceTracking shows a new code in a few seconds; type that one.
Type the 6-digit pairing code from VRCFaceTracking\'s Output page.
Looking for VRCFaceTracking on your network. On the PC, run VRCFaceTracking with \"Pico 4 Face Tracking\"; its Output page then shows a 6-digit pairing code.

Untick a part to send it as neutral (eyes open and looking ahead, or no mouth movement) while the other part keeps tracking.
Eye Tracking is switched off in the headset\'s Settings → LAB. Switch it on there; this app cannot track what the headset has switched off.
Face Tracking is switched off in the headset\'s Settings → LAB. Switch it on there; this app cannot track what the headset has switched off.
Eye Tracking and Face Tracking are switched off in the headset\'s Settings → LAB. Switch them on there; this app cannot track what the headset has switched off.
Pause while another app uses eye and face tracking, for example PICO Connect (it feeds VRCFaceTracking\'s Pico4SAFT module itself)
Tongue out, eye widen maximum, blink strength, smoothing and an editor for all 52 expressions.
%1$s They are not part of this build: the APK on the GitHub Releases page includes them, unlocked by a supporter licence. Licences are not available yet.
%1$s They unlock with a supporter licence file, which is not available yet. If you have one, put the .licence file next to Install face tracking app.bat and run it, or import it here.

Unlocked, %1$s. Thank you for supporting the app.

Paired by key. The PC\'s address can change, and the data is encrypted. The address below is not used.
Paired by address (no pairing key). Pairing by code adds encryption and keeps working when the PC\'s address changes; it needs \"Pico 4 Face Tracking\" in VRCFaceTracking.

Paired PC (the PC running VRCFaceTracking). Only this PC can receive your tracking data. Leave it empty to pair with the first PC on your network that runs VRCFaceTracking; clear it to pair again, for example when the PC gets a new address.
Enter the PC\'s address, for example 192.168.1.20, or leave it empty
Start when the headset turns on

Install VRCFaceTracking on the PC, then install the \"Pico 4 Face Tracking\" module in VRCFaceTracking (it can pair by code), or thoricelli\'s Pico Facial Data Module, which pairs by address. Pico4SAFTExtTrackingModule can stay installed: it only starts while PICO Connect or Streaming Assistant runs on the PC. Tracking only flows while the headset is worn.
If the PC does not connect

Pico 4 Face Tracking only takes over eye and face tracking if this headset answers within 5 seconds of VRCFaceTracking starting. If VRCFaceTracking was started before tracking was switched on here (or before the headset was on), its log says \"No PICO headset answered\": switch tracking on, then restart VRCFaceTracking.
If tracking does not come back by itself, open this app once. It opens as a panel next to Virtual Desktop without closing it.
Stop tracking and close the app
Tracking starts again the next time you open this app or restart the headset. To keep it off, switch off \"Face and eye tracking\" at the top instead.
While this tab is open, the headset\'s eye and face tracking runs even if tracking is switched off on the Settings tab. Nothing is sent to the PC from here.

Look around: the dots follow your eyes (big dot: both eyes, blue: left eye, orange: right eye). The edges of the square are about 30° from straight ahead. Blink or close your eyes: the eyelids below close with them.

PICO\'s face and mouth tracking may not be accurate: some expressions move only a little, move when you are not making them, or do not move at all. This shows what the headset detects, which is what VRCFaceTracking receives.
Open your mouth, smile, pucker, puff your cheeks or stick out your tongue.
The values as the headset reports them, before the eyes and mouth switches and the tracking adjustments. Grey: the headset does not see that part of the face.
Starting the headset\'s eye and face tracking
